slots.name: naturally aspirated variants
slots.sentence: In Porsche’s lineup, the only naturally aspirated (nonturbo) holdouts are four 911 GT3 variants; all other models have turbocharged gas engines.

slots.name: Corvette horsepower
slots.sentence: Turbo engines propel many Chevrolet vehicles, including the automaker’s three sub-$30,000 crossovers and its 1,064-horsepower Corvette ZR1.

slots.name: Hyundai turbo share
slots.sentence: Hyundai has nearly 30 percent turbos in its sales mix, including some hybrids.

slots.name: CR-V engine displacement
slots.sentence: The Honda CR-V, one of the most popular vehicles in America, has a 1.5-liter turbo four-cylinder engine standard.

slots.name: Charger horsepower
slots.sentence: In its road test of the 550-horsepower, twin-turbo six-cylinder Dodge Charger Scat Pack, Motor Trend said, “power delivery feels immediate and linear.”
